title: Triage
empty_description: New submissions will appear here for review.
disabled: Triage is disabled. History remains available.
unsupported: This server does not support triage yet.
disabled_hint: Enable triage in workspace settings to submit or reopen tasks.
settings_description: Review explicit submissions before they join the workspace’s formal work. Ordinary task creation keeps its existing behavior.
sources: T1 accepts manual submissions and UTF-8 CSV files.
admin_only: Only owners and admins can change these settings.
pending_block: {{count}} unresolved tasks remain, including snoozed tasks. Resolve them before disabling triage.
responsibility_hint: Applies to new submissions only. Review responsibility does not assign task execution.
creator: Submitted by
accept_hint: These fields are saved together with acceptance. Accept does not start an agent.
execute_hint: Starts the selected agent or squad leader after acceptance, using your current invoke permission.
create_hint: This task stays pending. Mentions and candidate assignments do not start execution.
admission_hint: This task has not been admitted to formal work. Execution is unavailable; comments and attachments remain available.
duplicate_target: Target task ID or task link
duplicate_hint: Choose a formal task in this workspace, including completed tasks. Comments and attachments stay on this submission.
invalid_duplicate_link: Choose a task link from this workspace.
target_unavailable: The target was deleted. Its historical reference is retained.
invalid_snooze: Choose a future time within 90 days.
execution_failed: Accepted, but execution did not start
refresh_conflict: The task may have changed. Your input is preserved; refresh the current task before submitting a new decision.
batch_hint: Only the tasks you explicitly selected are included. Each task is committed independently.
csv_hint: UTF-8 CSV, up to 5 MiB and 1,000 data rows. Previewing does not create tasks.

csv_template.title: Start from the template
csv_template.summary: The first row holds column names and each following row is one task. Only the title is required. Column names may be in English or Chinese, and you can remap them after uploading.
csv_template.formats: Priority accepts urgent, high, medium, low or none, in any letter case. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD.
csv_template.encoding: When saving from Excel, choose "CSV UTF-8". Replace the example rows before importing.

fields.title: Required, up to 500 characters
fields.priority: urgent, high, medium, low or none. The Chinese UI labels also work. Empty means none
fields.due_date: YYYY-MM-DD, not before the start date
fields.external_id: ID from the source system. Rows already imported are skipped by default

csv_template.matching: Labels, projects and assignees are matched by name. Unmatched values are left empty with a warning and nothing is created. Status, iteration and attachment columns are not imported.

invalid_utf8: The file is not valid UTF-8. Save it as UTF-8 CSV and try again.
file_too_large: The file exceeds the 5 MiB limit.
mapping_hint: Map each header to a supported field, or ignore it. Status, iterations and attachments are not adopted.
csv_confirm_hint: Selecting a row confirms its warnings. Invalid rows cannot be imported. Duplicate external IDs are skipped unless you explicitly override them.
snapshot_names_hint: Related objects use their current names. The recorded decisions and field values remain unchanged.
execution_managed_runtime: Runtime managed by the agent owner
execution_no_project_resources: No project resources. The agent uses its runtime defaults.
execution_configured_machine: Used only on its configured machine

execution_readiness.ready: Ready to accept and execute. The server rechecks before starting.
execution_readiness.check_failed: Could not verify execution prerequisites. Retry before confirming.
execution_readiness.choose_executor: Choose an agent or an AI squad to execute this task.
execution_readiness.executor_unavailable: The selected executor is unavailable. Choose another executor.
execution_readiness.invoke_denied: You do not have permission to invoke this executor.
execution_readiness.runtime_unavailable: The executor’s runtime is unavailable or offline. Connect it before executing.
execution_readiness.project_unavailable: The selected project is unavailable. Choose another project.
execution_readiness.resource_unavailable: A project resource is unavailable or has invalid configuration. Correct it before executing.
